    from models import Note

      result = open_note(Path('dummy_path.json'))

  def test_run_parser_arguments(mocker):
      mock_args = mocker.Mock()
      mock_args.input = Path("/path/to/input")
      mock_args.output = Path("/path/to/output")
      
      mock_parser = mocker.patch("argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args", return_value=mock_args)

  def test_convert_process_json_files(mocker):
      mock_read_path = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_write_path = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      
      mock_json_file = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_json_file.is_file.return_value = True
      mock_json_file.suffix = '.json'
      
      mock_read_path.iterdir.return_value = [mock_json_file]
      
      mock_note = mocker.Mock(spec=Note)
      mock_note.is_empty.return_value = False
      
      mock_open_note = mocker.patch("convert.open_note", return_value=mock_note)
      mock_write_or_append_note = mocker.patch("convert.write_or_append_note")
      
      convert_module.convert(mock_read_path, mock_write_path)
      
      mock_read_path.iterdir.assert_called_once()
      mock_open_note.assert_called_once_with(mock_json_file)
      mock_note.is_empty.assert_called_once()
      mock_write_or_append_note.assert_called_once_with(mock_note, mock_write_path)
  
  
  def test_write_or_append_note(mocker):
      mock_note = mocker.Mock(spec=Note)
      mock_note.date_string = "2023-10-01"
      mock_note.to_markdown_string.return_value = "# Test Note\nThis is a test note."
      
      mock_root_path = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_file_path = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_root_path.joinpath.return_value = mock_file_path
      mock_file_path.is_file.return_value = False
      
      mock_open = mocker.patch("builtins.open", mocker.mock_open())
      
      convert_module.write_or_append_note(mock_note, mock_root_path)
      
      mock_root_path.joinpath.assert_called_once_with("2023-10-01.md")
      mock_open.assert_called_once_with(mock_file_path, 'w')
      mock_open().write.assert_called_once_with("# Test Note\nThis is a test note.")
  
  
  def test_open_note_valid_json(mocker):
      mock_json_fpath = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_open = mocker.patch("builtins.open", mocker.mock_open(read_data='{"title": "Test Note", "content": "This is a test note."}'))
      mock_load = mocker.patch("json.load", return_value={"title": "Test Note", "content": "This is a test note."})
      mock_note_schema = mocker.patch("convert.NoteSchema")
      mock_note = mocker.Mock(spec=Note)
      mock_note_schema.return_value.load.return_value = mock_note
  
      result = convert_module.open_note(mock_json_fpath)
  
      mock_open.assert_called_once_with(mock_json_fpath, 'r')
      mock_load.assert_called_once()
      mock_note_schema.return_value.load.assert_called_once_with({"title": "Test Note", "content": "This is a test note."})
      assert result == mock_note

  def test_main_calls_convert_with_correct_args(mocker):
      mock_convert = mocker.patch('convert.convert')
      mock_run_parser = mocker.patch('convert.run_parser')
      mock_args = mocker.Mock()
      mock_args.input = Path('/fake/input')
      mock_args.output = Path('/fake/output')
      mock_run_parser.return_value = mock_args
  
      convert_module.main()
  
      mock_convert.assert_called_once_with(Path('/fake/input'), Path('/fake/output'))
  
  
  def test_run_parser_arguments(mocker):
      mock_args = ['input_path', 'output_path']
      mocker.patch('sys.argv', ['convert.py'] + mock_args)
      args = convert_module.run_parser()
      assert args.input == Path('input_path')
      assert args.output == Path('output_path')
  
  
  def test_convert_process_json_files(mocker):
      mock_json_file = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_json_file.is_file.return_value = True
      mock_json_file.suffix = '.json'
      mock_read_path = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_read_path.iterdir.return_value = [mock_json_file]
  
      mock_note = mocker.Mock(spec=Note)
      mock_note.is_empty.return_value = False
      mocker.patch('convert.open_note', return_value=mock_note)
      mock_write_or_append_note = mocker.patch('convert.write_or_append_note')
  
      convert_module.convert(mock_read_path, Path("dummy_output_path"))
  
      mock_write_or_append_note.assert_called_once_with(mock_note, Path("dummy_output_path"))
  
  
  def test_write_or_append_note(mocker):
      mock_note = mocker.Mock(spec=Note)
      mock_note.date_string = "2023-10-01"
      mock_note.to_markdown_string.return_value = "# Sample Note\n\nThis is a sample note.\n"
  
      mock_file = mocker.mock_open()
      mocker.patch('builtins.open', mock_file)
      mock_path = mocker.Mock(spec=Path)
      mock_path.joinpath.return_value.is_file.return_value = False
  
      convert_module.write_or_append_note(mock_note, mock_path)
      mock_file.assert_called_once_with(mock_path.joinpath.return_value, 'w')
      mock_file().write.assert_called_once_with("# Sample Note\n\nThis is a sample note.\n")

      assert note == mock_note

    # Create mock JSON files
    json_content1 = {'title': 'Note 1', 'content': 'Content 1', 'date_string': '2023-10-01'}
    json_content2 = {'title': 'Note 2', 'content': 'Content 2', 'date_string': '2023-10-02'}
    json_file1 = tmp_path / "note1.json"
    json_file2 = tmp_path / "note2.json"

    type(mock_note1).date_string = property(lambda self: '2023-10-01')

    mock_note2.is_empty = lambda: False

def test_convert_processes_json_files(tmp_path):
    from convert import convert
    from models import NoteSchema, Note
    import json

    # Create input and output directories
    input_dir = tmp_path / "input"
    output_dir = tmp_path / "output"
    input_dir.mkdir()
    output_dir.mkdir()

    # Create JSON files in the input directory
    note_data_1 = {'title': 'Note 1', 'content': 'Content 1', 'date': '2024-01-01T00:00:00'}
    note_data_2 = {'title': 'Note 2', 'content': '', 'date': '2024-01-02T00:00:00'}  # Empty content
    with open(input_dir / "note1.json", 'w') as f:
        json.dump(note_data_1, f)
    with open(input_dir / "note2.json", 'w') as f:
        json.dump(note_data_2, f)

    # Run the convert function
    convert_module.convert(input_dir, output_dir)

    # Check that only the non-empty note was written to the output directory
    output_files = list(output_dir.iterdir())
    assert len(output_files) == 1
    assert output_files[0].name == "2024-01-01T00:00:00.md"

  def test_convert_process_json_files(mocker):
      mock_note = mocker.Mock()
      mock_note.is_empty.return_value = False
      mock_open_note = mocker.patch('convert.open_note', return_value=mock_note)
      mock_write_or_append_note = mocker.patch('convert.write_or_append_note')
  
      read_path = Path('/json_notes')
      write_path = Path('/markdown_notes')
      mock_iterdir = mocker.patch.object(Path, 'iterdir', return_value=[
          Path('/json_notes/note1.json'),
          Path('/json_notes/note2.json')
      ])
      mock_is_file = mocker.patch.object(Path, 'is_file', return_value=True)
      mock_suffix = mocker.patch.object(Path, 'suffix', new_callable=mocker.PropertyMock, return_value='.json')
  
      convert_module.convert(read_path, write_path)
  
      mock_open_note.assert_any_call(Path('/json_notes/note1.json'))
      mock_open_note.assert_any_call(Path('/json_notes/note2.json'))
      mock_write_or_append_note.assert_any_call(mock_note, write_path)
  
  
  def test_write_or_append_note_new_file(mocker):
      mock_note = mocker.Mock()
      mock_note.date_string = '2023-10-01'
      mock_note.to_markdown_string.return_value = '# Test Note'
  
      root_path = Path('/notes')
      file_path = root_path / '2023-10-01.md'
      mock_open = mocker.patch('builtins.open', mocker.mock_open())
      mock_is_file = mocker.patch.object(Path, 'is_file', return_value=False)
  
      convert_module.write_or_append_note(mock_note, root_path)
  
      mock_open.assert_called_once_with(file_path, 'w')
      mock_open().write.assert_called_once_with('# Test Note')
  
  
  def test_open_note_valid_json(mocker):
      mock_note = mocker.Mock()
      mock_note_schema = mocker.patch('convert.NoteSchema')
      mock_note_schema.return_value.load.return_value = mock_note
  
      json_fpath = Path('valid_note.json')
      mock_open = mocker.patch('builtins.open', mocker.mock_open(read_data='{"title": "Test Note"}'))
      mock_json_load = mocker.patch('json.load', return_value={"title": "Test Note"})
  
      note = convert_module.open_note(json_fpath)
  
      mock_open.assert_called_once_with(json_fpath, 'r')
      mock_json_load.assert_called_once()
      mock_note_schema.return_value.load.assert_called_once_with({"title": "Test Note"})
      assert note == mock_note
